name: Hotel-pension
description: Small seaside hotel-pension, 19.2 x 11.2 m, three storeys and an attic: buff brick with white-rendered quoins, bands, architraves and a deep white modillion cornice (after the reference pack's corner townhouse), a glazed double entrance under a glass-and-iron marquise, a lettered sign band, a long iron balcony across the first floor, a slate roof with a rendered central gable, six dormers and four stacks. Dining room, reception hall and salon; six guest rooms; an attic; two stairs.
